+    let sf = i64_to_f64(sc) / 100.0

+    let t = 2.0 * lf - 1.0
+    let at = if t < 0.0 { 0.0 - t } else { t }

+    let k = hh / 60
+    let frac = i64_to_f64(hh - k * 60) / 60.0
+    let m2 = i64_to_f64(k % 2) + frac
+    let t2 = m2 - 1.0

+    let r1 = 0.0
+    let g1 = 0.0
+    let b1 = 0.0
